subject: Portal boarding checkpoint — evidence sprint & window coordination
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@clearlake.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic/portal boarding — light onboarding + evidence window

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo on Tuesday. We’re starting the security intake for Redwood as part of our procurement checklist and want to get the Whistic profile and evidence handoff scheduled.

A few asks up front so we can scope the work on our side:
- Can you confirm the representative (email) who will receive our presigned S3 upload links?
- Do you have a preferred manifest format (CSV vs JSON) for bulk evidence?
- Are there specific SOC 2 sections you want as a first pass (SysSec/Encryption/Change Mgmt)?

We plan to upload a CAIQ snapshot and our latest SOC 2 Type II report. I can share as attachments or a presigned S3 link if that’s easier.

Proposed window for the evidence sprint: May 18–20 (we have internal compliance bandwidth those days). If that doesn’t work for your team, suggest alternatives.

Elena Torres
Security Program Manager
ClearLake Financial
Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, CAIQ_snapshot_202705.zip
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@clearlake.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic/portal boarding — light onboarding + evidence window

Elena — great to meet you in the call. Thanks for the heads-up and for the attachments.

Quick answers and plan from our side:
- Presigned uploads: please send presigned S3 links to security-uploads@redwood.com (we use an ingestion bucket and a short TTL). That inbox is monitored by our portal ops team.
- Manifest: CSV is easiest for our ingestion flow; columns we prefer: filename, sha256, evidence_type, source, created_at. I’ve copied a one-line CSV template below.
- First-pass SOC2 scope: please prioritize SOC2 CC6 (Access Control), CC7 (Change Management), and CC8 (System Operations) — those map directly to Whistic fields we flag for reviewers.

Evidence sprint approach:
1) You upload artifacts to presigned links the week of May 18.
2) Our portal ops team will run a quick QA and assign any missing CAIQ mappings.
3) We’ll do a 30-minute triage sync on Day 2 to resolve gaps.

Can we lock a 30-minute slot on May 19 at 11:00 AM PT for the triage sync? If so, I’ll send a calendar invite.

One-line CSV template: filename,sha256,evidence_type,source,created_at

Thanks — copying Jonas (QA lead) and Kimberly (portal onboarding).

— Ava
Ava Chen
Manager, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena@clearlake.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 15:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic/portal boarding — light onboarding + evidence window

Thanks Ava / Elena — a couple of nitty-gritty items before the sprint so we don’t hit blockers: 

1) Service account for manifest ingestion: how will you authenticate when POSTing manifests to our intake API? We accept a short-lived JWT (recommended) or an ephemeral HMAC key. If you need us to create an escrowed service account, we can do that and provide a one-time provision link.

2) CAIQ mapping: if you can include a CAIQ JSON export, it speeds mapping. The ZIP is fine, but call out which file inside is the CAIQ export.

3) GovCloud constraint: Elena — you mentioned some artifacts are in a GovCloud bucket. Presigned URL uploads into our US-east ingestion bucket are allowed, but we need an explicit note about cross-region transfer in the manifest to satisfy audit tracing.

If everyone agrees, I’ll prepare the onboarding checklist and a short SRE runbook we can attach to the ticket.

Subject: Re: Whistic/portal boarding — light onboarding + evidence window

Ava / Jonas — thanks, we can do the proposed flow. Quick updates: 

- I’ve uploaded the SOC2 and CAIQ export to a temporary presigned bucket and included the links below (ttl 72h). I’m also attaching a short service-account policy doc that explains our auth approach.
- Auth approach: we can POST manifests using an ephemeral JWT issued by our identity provider; we’ll include the kid header so you can verify. If you prefer Redwood-created credentials, we can accept a one-time provision link.
- GovCloud: the CAIQ includes a note (field: data_residency) — we’ll include that in the CSV manifest as the source column value.

Presigned links (temporary):
- https://clearlake-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/evidence/SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf?X-EXAMPLE
- https://clearlake-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/evidence/CAIQ_snapshot_202705.zip?X-EXAMPLE

We can take the triage sync on May 19 at 11:00 AM PT — please send the invite.

Thanks — attaching: service-account-policy.md

Elena
Security Program Manager
ClearLake Financial
